title: Spring Batch & Scheduling
intro: Spring Batch interviews test whether you understand batch as a pattern with its own architecture, not just a loop. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with batch fundamentals (why batch, the Job/Step model), then job and step structure, then chunk processing (the core pattern — reader/processor/writer). Item readers/writers/processors and error handling follow at the mechanics tier, then scheduling (Spring's @Scheduled and Quartz) at the applied tier. Partitioning and parallel steps close the advanced tier, then comparisons and scenario-based questions.
